_readme: Per-app JS budgets, gzip KB (TASK-031; every dimension blocking since TASK-022). `initialKb` counts SvelteKit entry+chunks; for the SPAs it is the Vite manifest entry's static import closure (what the script + modulepreload chain loads at boot) — measured 74.6 KB for admin and 40.9 KB for platform-admin in rc.3, budgeted with headroom inside the architecture's admin ≤ 250 target. The per-route `routeKb` and the SPA per-chunk `chunkKb` cap every other chunk. `fonts` budgets the Japanese preloaded subsets raw (woff2 is already compressed) as their own line — a single global font number would hide the one hard locale. TASK-032 had lowered storefront initial to 88 and marketing to 50 after sharding the i18n catalogs.

lighthouse._readme: TASK-022's blocking Lighthouse assertions: medians-of-3 on the pinned profile, asserted by check-lighthouse (calibrated against benchmarks/frontend/VARIANCE.md — median LCP ~6% noise, scores ±0.02). Millisecond caps carry host headroom above the local rc.4 measurement because devtools throttling multiplies HOST latency (benchmarkIndex records the class); the DoD's own ms evidence is the committed rc artifact compared same-host. Scores and CLS are dimensionless and asserted tightly. The SPAs assert no LCP/perf: the harness leaves their API origin unanswered, so those numbers measure the boot-error path — a harness artifact (rc.3's call-pattern audit, F10) — not the product; TBT/CLS/scores still gate them. SPA SEO is unasserted (0.45 is the known pre-prerender shell state).
